how to become unbelievably
articulate and well spoken

reading out loud

read one page out loud every day, slowly and clearly. your mouth learns the rhythm of good sentences, and soon you start speaking in them without trying.

one new word a day

learn one precise word a day and use it in a real sentence before night. people who choose exact words always sound smarter than people who reach for big ones.

cutting the fillers

for a week, replace every "like" and "um" with a short silence. a pause sounds thoughtful, a filler sounds nervous, and every listener hears the difference instantly, even if they can't say why.

five minute topics

spend 5 minutes a day learning about a topic you can't talk about yet: an art movement, a scientific idea, a historical event. you can't speak well about things you don't know.
slides.texte_sophia:
five minute topics

spend 5 minutes a day on a topic you can't talk about yet: an art movement, a scientific idea. a micro-learning app like the Sophia app makes it easy. you can't speak well about what you don't know.

slides.texte_overlay:
explaining in one minute

pick one idea a day and explain it out loud in under a minute, as if to a friend. learning to be short and clear is the whole secret of sounding articulate.
